title: Rivals author Jilly Cooper accused of ‘extensive and deliberate plagiarism’
summary_full: Analysis reportedly finds striking similarities in dialogue and narrative structure between late author’s novel, Prudence, and two of her contemporariesJilly Cooper has been accused of plagiarising the works of two other novelists.The bestselling author’s fifth romance series novel, Prudence, published in 1978, allegedly includes several plagiarised passages from The Serial by Cyra McFadden and The Franchise Affair by Josephine Tey.
